summary_en: Researchers Ben Geist and Thomas Villeneuve introduced the Speculative Encoding framework, designed to resolve KV Cache format translation issues between models of different architectures and scales. ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 研究者Ben Geist与Thomas Villeneuve提出了Speculative Encoding框架，用于解决不同架构与规模的模型在协作交互中的KV缓存（Key-Value Cache）格式转换问题。该技术旨在消除多智能体集群中模型切换时的重计算损耗，实现上下文信息在异构模型间的直接迁移与共享。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Researchers Ben Geist and Thomas Villeneuve introduced the Speculative Encoding framework, designed to resolve KV Cache format translation issues between models of different architectures and scales. The technology aims to eliminate re-computation overhead during model switching in multi-agent clusters, enabling direct transfer and sharing of context information across heterogeneous models.

elements_zh.where: 多智能体推理系统架构
elements_zh.what: 开发Speculative Encoding技术实现多模型间的KV缓存格式转换
elements_zh.why: 解决大模型路由与多智能体集群协作时上下文传输的计算延迟与损耗

elements_en.what: Developed Speculative Encoding for cross-model KV Cache format translation
elements_en.why: To minimize computational latency and overhead during context transfer in LLM routing and multi-agent systems

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 随着大模型路由架构（LLM Routing）走向成熟，KV缓存的互操作性已成为制约推理侧集群效率的关键瓶颈。该研究标志着推理优化视角从单模型加速向系统级协同优化演进，未来该类技术将决定多智能体协作系统的实际吞吐上限。
ai_analysis.insight_en: As LLM routing architectures mature, the interoperability of KV Caches has become a critical bottleneck for inference cluster efficiency. This research marks an evolution from single-model optimization to system-level collaborative optimization, where such technologies will determine the practical throughput limits of multi-agent collaborative systems.

title: We spent a long time deciding how to do telemetry in Hermes. We delayed it as long as we could and only added it when we really felt we were doing a disservice to the community by not having a clear picture on what features to focus on and what failure case
title_en:
We spent a long time deciding how to do telemetry in Hermes. 

We delayed it as long as we could and only added it when we really felt we were doing a disservice to the community by not having a clear picture on what features to focus on and what failure cases were most common.

When we did decide to do it, I will admit there was always the temptation to sort of "accidently" make it enabled all the time or to have some happy path that would end with it enabled with zero user interaction.

In the end though we stuck to our guns that Hermes should be privacy-preserving and always "on the side of the user"

我们花了很长时间决定如何在 Hermes 中进行遥测。

title: I’ve been spending the entire evening wandering around in Guangzhou. Here are a few things that stood out: - mega clean, like in 6 ours I only saw one stray small translucent plastic bag You could probably walk barefoot and not get dirty feet. - kids everywher
title_en:
I’ve been spending the entire evening wandering around in Guangzhou.

Here are a few things that stood out:

- mega clean, like in 6 ours I only saw one stray small translucent plastic bag
You could probably walk barefoot and not get dirty feet. 

- kids everywhere, even at 10pm when the shops closed, people had their kids in strollers, or walking or scootering around. 

- everything is walkable, and taxis are like $6 for 20-30min of riding. 

- no engine sounds anywhere, 90% of the cars here are electric, 99% of the small moped/scooters are electric 

- they are mega capitalists here, I have never seen shops so full of people, not even in Spain during Christmas. walked into Apple Store and I could barely move around. 

- people will help you with anything, did not matter who I stoped on the street, if they don’t speak English, they rip up their phones and starts a translation app. 

- people work hard, and then they checkout and go play sports, the entire city seems to be obsessed with work and sporting (and shopping). 

- every single western brand is operating here, every last one of them, even the defunct ones. 

- I have no seen a single homeless person, nor have I seen any suspicious person, I have not even seen a police officer in service, only a few civilian dressed cops. 

- CCTV is everywhere, like literally everywhere, you can’t commit a crime, because you can’t hide. Someone will catch you on video. 

- I have a temporary Chinese drivers license, took ~60min. 

- you can buy coffee, matcha, food, street food, anything you need absolutely everywhere. 360 options. 

- people are polite and smile and does not try to get in your way, even tho I smell of tourist from miles away. 

- everything that’s new is absolutely flashing new and ultra high quality, and everything that’s olds is very old… I guess that comes with the territory of growing like crazy. 

- the construction is constant, even at 11pm the construction sites all around are active, I suspect they work shifts and 24/7 until they are done. 

- I put my bag down while filming and walked prob 50 yards from it, hundreds of people passing by, my bag was not even touched. 

- the city is so green, and well trimmed, I’ll record more in daylight to make it justice. Smells of magnolia and flowers almost everywhere, except when you pass by a durian vendor

- English is spoken by many, often they feel embarrassed when talking, but they  speak very well. A few folks have not spoken but quickly use translation apps like mention prior. 

- prices are cheap, but not globally priced products like Apple. I bought some stuff today at 30-40% discount from Euro-price.

- getting a fancy appointment at a high end barbershop is $12 

- an all exclusive, all you can eat and drink day at a Spa, with all the high-end amenities, $120 for a full day, saunas, pools, treatments

- the cyberpunk vibes are real. No hiding that. Building are plastered with LED lights, and it’s all synchronised. 

So after a full day of Robotics and electric vehicles it was nice to get outside. Tomorrow I’ll do some more filming and reporting.
title_zh:
我整个晚上都在广州闲逛。

以下是一些突出的事情：

- 超级干净，就像我们 6 个人一样，我只看到一个零散的小半透明塑料袋
你也许可以赤脚走路而不会弄脏脚。

- 到处都有孩子，即使是晚上 10 点商店关门的时候，人们还是带着孩子推着婴儿
author: Linus Ekenstam
author_role: AI 生成式创意设计策展人
summary_zh:
车，或者步行或骑滑板车四处走动。

- 一切都适合步行，乘坐出租车 20-30 分钟大约 6 美元。

- 任何地方都没有引擎声音，这里 90% 的汽车是电动的，99% 的小型轻便摩托车/踏板车是电动的

- 他们是这里的超级资本家，我从来没有见过商店里如此挤满人，甚至在西班牙圣诞节期间也没有见过。走进Apple Store，我几乎无法走动。

- 人们会在任何事情上帮助你，不管我在街上拦住谁，如果他们不会说英语，他们就会撕毁手机并启动翻译应用程序。

- 人们努力工作，然后结帐并去运动，整个城市似乎都沉迷于工作和运动（和购物）。

- 每一个西方品牌都在这里经营，每一个品牌，甚至是已经不复存在的品牌。

- 我没有看到一个无家可归的人，也没有看到任何可疑的人，我什至没有看到正在服役的警察，只有几个穿着便服的警察。

- 闭路电视无处不在，就像字面上无处不在，你不能犯罪，因为你无法隐藏。有人会通过视频捕捉到您。

- 我有一个临时中国驾驶执照，花了大约60分钟。

- 你可以在任何地方买到咖啡、抹茶、食物、街头小吃，任何你需要的东西。 360 个选项。

- 人们很有礼貌，面带微笑，不会试图妨碍你，尽管我从几英里外就闻到了游客的味道。

- 所有新的东西都是绝对闪亮的新的和超高品质的，而所有旧的东西都是非常旧的......我想这伴随着疯狂增长的领域。

- 施工是持续进行的，即使在晚上 11 点，周围的建筑工地都在活跃，我怀疑他们轮班工作，24/7 直到完成。

- 我在拍摄时放下包，走了大约 50 码，数百人经过，我的包甚至没有被碰过。

- 这座城市是如此的绿色，而且修剪得很好，我会在白天录制更多以使其公正。几乎到处都有玉兰花和鲜花的气味，除了当你经过榴莲摊贩时

- 说英语的人很多，他们说话时常常感到尴尬，但他们说得很好。有些人还没有说过话，但很快就使用了之前提到的翻译应用程序。

- 价格便宜，但不是像苹果那样全球定价的产品。我今天买了一些东西，比欧元价格有 30-40% 的折扣。

- 在高端理发店预约一次高级理发店的费用为 12 美元

- 在水疗中心享受全天的、无限吃喝的一天，配备所有高端设施，全天 120 美元，包括桑拿、泳池、理疗

- 赛博朋克氛围真实存在。没有隐藏这一点。建筑物上贴满了 LED 灯，而且都是同步的。

因此，在玩了一整天的机器人和电动汽车之后，走出去真是太好了。明天我会做更多的拍摄和报道。

full_text_en:
I’ve been spending the entire evening wandering around in Guangzhou.

Here are a few things that stood out:

- mega clean, like in 6 ours I only saw one stray small translucent plastic bag
You could probably walk barefoot and not get dirty feet. 

- kids everywhere, even at 10pm when the shops closed, people had their kids in strollers, or walking or scootering around. 

- everything is walkable, and taxis are like $6 for 20-30min of riding. 

- no engine sounds anywhere, 90% of the cars here are electric, 99% of the small moped/scooters are electric 

- they are mega capitalists here, I have never seen shops so full of people, not even in Spain during Christmas. walked into Apple Store and I could barely move around. 

- people will help you with anything, did not matter who I stoped on the street, if they don’t speak English, they rip up their phones and starts a translation app. 

- people work hard, and then they checkout and go play sports, the entire city seems to be obsessed with work and sporting (and shopping). 

- every single western brand is operating here, every last one of them, even the defunct ones. 

- I have no seen a single homeless person, nor have I seen any suspicious person, I have not even seen a police officer in service, only a few civilian dressed cops. 

- CCTV is everywhere, like literally everywhere, you can’t commit a crime, because you can’t hide. Someone will catch you on video. 

- I have a temporary Chinese drivers license, took ~60min. 

- you can buy coffee, matcha, food, street food, anything you need absolutely everywhere. 360 options. 

- people are polite and smile and does not try to get in your way, even tho I smell of tourist from miles away. 

- everything that’s new is absolutely flashing new and ultra high quality, and everything that’s olds is very old… I guess that comes with the territory of growing like crazy. 

- the construction is constant, even at 11pm the construction sites all around are active, I suspect they work shifts and 24/7 until they are done. 

- I put my bag down while filming and walked prob 50 yards from it, hundreds of people passing by, my bag was not even touched. 

- the city is so green, and well trimmed, I’ll record more in daylight to make it justice. Smells of magnolia and flowers almost everywhere, except when you pass by a durian vendor

- English is spoken by many, often they feel embarrassed when talking, but they  speak very well. A few folks have not spoken but quickly use translation apps like mention prior. 

- prices are cheap, but not globally priced products like Apple. I bought some stuff today at 30-40% discount from Euro-price.

- getting a fancy appointment at a high end barbershop is $12 

- an all exclusive, all you can eat and drink day at a Spa, with all the high-end amenities, $120 for a full day, saunas, pools, treatments

- the cyberpunk vibes are real. No hiding that. Building are plastered with LED lights, and it’s all synchronised. 

So after a full day of Robotics and electric vehicles it was nice to get outside. Tomorrow I’ll do some more filming and reporting.
full_text_zh:
我整个晚上都在广州闲逛。

以下是一些突出的事情：

- 超级干净，就像我们 6 个人一样，我只看到一个零散的小半透明塑料袋
你也许可以赤脚走路而不会弄脏脚。

- 到处都有孩子，即使是晚上 10 点商店关门的时候，人们还是带着孩子推着婴儿车，或者步行或骑滑板车四处走动。

- 一切都适合步行，乘坐出租车 20-30 分钟大约 6 美元。

- 任何地方都没有引擎声音，这里 90% 的汽车是电动的，99% 的小型轻便摩托车/踏板车是电动的

- 他们是这里的超级资本家，我从来没有见过商店里如此挤满人，甚至在西班牙圣诞节期间也没有见过。走进Apple Store，我几乎无法走动。

- 人们会在任何事情上帮助你，不管我在街上拦住谁，如果他们不会说英语，他们就会撕毁手机并启动翻译应用程序。

- 人们努力工作，然后结帐并去运动，整个城市似乎都沉迷于工作和运动（和购物）。

- 每一个西方品牌都在这里经营，每一个品牌，甚至是已经不复存在的品牌。

- 我没有看到一个无家可归的人，也没有看到任何可疑的人，我什至没有看到正在服役的警察，只有几个穿着便服的警察。

- 闭路电视无处不在，就像字面上无处不在，你不能犯罪，因为你无法隐藏。有人会通过视频捕捉到您。

- 我有一个临时中国驾驶执照，花了大约60分钟。

- 你可以在任何地方买到咖啡、抹茶、食物、街头小吃，任何你需要的东西。 360 个选项。

- 人们很有礼貌，面带微笑，不会试图妨碍你，尽管我从几英里外就闻到了游客的味道。

- 所有新的东西都是绝对闪亮的新的和超高品质的，而所有旧的东西都是非常旧的......我想这伴随着疯狂增长的领域。

- 施工是持续进行的，即使在晚上 11 点，周围的建筑工地都在活跃，我怀疑他们轮班工作，24/7 直到完成。

- 我在拍摄时放下包，走了大约 50 码，数百人经过，我的包甚至没有被碰过。

- 这座城市是如此的绿色，而且修剪得很好，我会在白天录制更多以使其公正。几乎到处都有玉兰花和鲜花的气味，除了当你经过榴莲摊贩时

- 说英语的人很多，他们说话时常常感到尴尬，但他们说得很好。有些人还没有说过话，但很快就使用了之前提到的翻译应用程序。

- 价格便宜，但不是像苹果那样全球定价的产品。我今天买了一些东西，比欧元价格有 30-40% 的折扣。

- 在高端理发店预约一次高级理发店的费用为 12 美元

- 在水疗中心享受全天的、无限吃喝的一天，配备所有高端设施，全天 120 美元，包括桑拿、泳池、理疗

- 赛博朋克氛围真实存在。没有隐藏这一点。建筑物上贴满了 LED 灯，而且都是同步的。

因此，在玩了一整天的机器人和电动汽车之后，走出去真是太好了。明天我会做更多的拍摄和报道。

title: Proud to support @Baidu_ERNIE on vLLM with model plugin. Model plugin leverages the vLLM plugin mechanism to allow Out-of-Tree integration of day 0 support models. The model doesn't need to go through the time consuming vLLM code review for each
title_en:
Proud to support @Baidu_ERNIE on vLLM with model plugin. 

Model plugin leverages the vLLM plugin mechanism to allow Out-of-Tree integration of day 0 support models. The model doesn't need to go through the time consuming vLLM code review for each changes. 

Check out our blog on how it facilitate the integration from @Baidu_Inc team

https://vllm.ai/blog/2026-11-24-ernie-5-5-flash-preview
title_zh:
很自豪能够通过模型插件在 vLLM 上支持@Baidu_ERNIE。

模型插件利用 vLLM 插件机制来允许第 0 天支持模型的树外集成。该模型不需要对每次更改进行耗时的 vLLM 代码审查。

查看我们的博客，了解 @Baidu_Inc

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 推理加速框架vLLM正式支持模型插件机制，百度文心一言成为首批受益者。该方案允许开发者以Out-of-Tree方式接入模型，无需等待vLLM核心代码库的漫长审核流程，实现了模型的零日支持。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: The vLLM inference framework has introduced a model plugin mechanism, enabling Baidu's ERNIE to achieve day-zero integration. This approach allows for out-of-tree model support, bypassing the extensive code review process within the main vLLM repository.

elements_zh.who: 百度文心一言（Baidu ERNIE）开发团队
elements_zh.where: vLLM模型推理框架开源生态
elements_zh.what: 通过插件机制实现非侵入式（Out-of-Tree）模型集成
elements_zh.why: 降低大模型落地部署的工程门槛，提升各厂商私有化部署响应速度

elements_en.what: Out-of-tree model integration via plugin architecture
elements_en.why: Accelerate model deployment by bypassing core code reviews

ai_analysis.insight_zh: vLLM作为当前大模型推理的主流架构，开放插件生态意味着其正在从单一推理库向中立的AI底层基础设施演进。对于各厂商而言，这种解耦机制有效规避了核心仓的准入壁垒，将成为大模型厂商争夺推理引擎控制权的关键一步。
ai_analysis.insight_en: By enabling an open plugin ecosystem, vLLM is shifting from a proprietary inference library to a neutral AI infrastructure layer. This decoupling lowers deployment barriers, allowing model providers to circumvent bottlenecked upstream code reviews while securing their standing in the high-performance inference market.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 推理加速框架vLLM正式支持模型插件机制，百度文心一言成为首批受益者。该方案允许开发者以Out-of-Tree方式接入模型，无需等待vLLM核心代码库的漫长审核流程，实现了模型的零日支持。
ai_analysis.digest_en: The vLLM inference framework has introduced a model plugin mechanism, enabling Baidu's ERNIE to achieve day-zero integration. This approach allows for out-of-tree model support, bypassing the extensive code review process within the main vLLM repository.
key_points_zh: vLLM启用Out-of-Tree插件架构
百度文心一言实现推理框架的零日部署
显著提升大模型生产环境的工程交付效率

A model is given a molecule and has to work backwards until every piece is commercially available. A verifier grades every step it proposes.

We RL trained Qwen3.8-27B on it and its solve rate went up by 2.9x

Built in collaboration with @try_litefold

title: Linus Torvalds just blasted ext4 developer for his 41,197 lines of AI-assisted code. Reason... first it is a huge change ... 41,000+ lines of code... and it arrived late for the kernel 7.4 release cycle. And that made Torvalds go in his usual rage mode.
title_en: Linus Torvalds just blasted ext4 developer for his 41,197 lines of AI-assisted code. Reason... first it is a huge change ... 41,000+ lines of code... and it arrived late for the kernel 7.4 release cycle. And that made Torvalds go in his usual rage mode.
title_zh: Linus Torvalds严厉批评AI辅助生成的内核代码
author: @Itsfoss
summary_en: Linux kernel maintainer Linus Torvalds has rejected a submission of 41,197 lines of code from an ext4 file system developer. The code, purportedly generated with AI assistance, was criticized for its massive scale and failure to adhere to the submission deadline for the Linux Kernel 7.4 release cycle.
summary_zh: Linus Torvalds拒绝了ext4文件系统开发者提交的4.1万行AI辅助生成的代码，指出其规模过大且未能在内核发布周期前提交。
full_text_zh: Linus Torvalds 刚刚抨击了 ext4 开发者的 41,197 行人工智能辅助代码。原因...首先，这是一个巨大的变化...41,000 多行代码...而且它在内核 7.4 发布周期中迟到了。这让托瓦尔兹进入了他惯常的愤怒模式。
quote_zh: Linus Torvalds 刚刚抨击了 ext4 开发者的 41,197 行人工智能辅助代码。原因...首先，这是一个巨大的变化...41,000 多行代码...而且它对于内核 7.4 版本 cyc 来说姗姗来迟
full_text_en: Linus Torvalds just blasted ext4 developer for his 41,197 lines of AI-assisted code. Reason... first it is a huge change ... 41,000+ lines of code... and it arrived late for the kernel 7.4 release cycle. And that made Torvalds go in his usual rage mode.

ai_analysis.briefing_en: Linux kernel maintainer Linus Torvalds has rejected a submission of 41,197 lines of code from an ext4 file system developer. elements_zh.where: Linux Kernel 7.4 发布周期管理
elements_zh.what: 拒绝合并包含4.1万行AI辅助生成的ext4文件系统代码
elements_zh.why: 代码质量与可维护性审查压力过大，且违反了内核发布时间表

elements_en.what: Rejected a 41,197-line AI-assisted ext4 code patch
elements_en.why: Excessive review burden on core maintainers and failure to meet release deadlines

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 此事件凸显了AI驱动的超大规模代码生成与传统软件工程严谨性之间的冲突。在高性能计算领域，维持内核的可审计性与稳定性远高于代码产出效率，盲目的AI代码注入正在挑战以人工审查为核心的开源合规体系。
ai_analysis.insight_en: This incident highlights the friction between high-volume AI code generation and the rigorous standards of traditional software engineering. In high-performance systems, auditability and stability outweigh mere output speed, suggesting that AI-assisted code injection poses a significant challenge to human-centric open-source compliance models.

title: This growth scare worry about semis and the AI Revolution buildout is weighing heavily on tech stocks…and this will prove to be disconnected from the reality of this massive AI infrastructure path in our view @BloombergTV
title_en: This growth scare worry about semis and the AI Revolution buildout is weighing heavily on tech stocks…and this will prove to be disconnected from the reality of this massive AI infrastructure path in our view @BloombergTV
title_zh: AI基础设施建设与半导体股价脱节分析
author: @DivesTech
summary_en: Recent volatility in the semiconductor sector, driven by growth anxiety, is viewed by analysts as disconnected from the actual buildout of global AI infrastructure. title: Many $TSLA and $SPCX investors simply refuse to do the merger math to figure out whether a SPCX-TSLA deal will help TSLA shareholders, who have underperformed the market for 5 years now. If you assume an all-stock deal where SPCX acquires TSLA a
title_en:
Many $TSLA and $SPCX investors simply refuse to do the merger math to figure out whether a SPCX-TSLA deal will help TSLA shareholders, who have underperformed the market for 5 years now.  

If you assume an all-stock deal where SPCX acquires TSLA at a 25% nominal premium, and then project out proforma market caps, SPCX needs to issue roughly +52% new SPCX shares to “acquire” TSLA.  That 52% dilution will act as a weight that drags down $TSLA stock price as merger arbs sell forward their $SPCX shares expected to be received on the deal close in maybe 12 months if a deal is announced before year-end.  

That is exactly what has happened in the $MRVL- $LITE deal where $MRVL and $LITE are down -23% and -29% respectively since the deal was announced on Nov 2, as the target $LITE shares are now tied mathematically to $MRVL shares which are being diluted. One can argue TSLA-SPCX won’t be the same since MRVL-LITE is being driven more by the weakness in AI shares generally, but this is the same pattern we see in most dilutive stock-for-stock deals.

summary_zh:
易，然后预测预计市值，SPCX 需要发行大约 +52% 的新 SPCX 股票才能“收购”TSLA。 如果交易在年底前宣布，那么 52% 的稀释将成为拖累 TSLA 股价的一个因素，因为合并套利者将远期出售其预计在 12 个月内交易完成时收到的 SPCX 股票。

这正是 $MRVL-$LITE 交易中发生的情况，自 11 月 2 日宣布交易以来，$MRVL 和 $LITE 分别下跌了 -23% 和 -29%，因为目标 $LITE 股票现在在数学上与正在稀释的 $MRVL 股票挂钩。有人可能会说 TSLA-SPCX 不会一样，因为 MRVL-LITE 更多地是受到人工智能股票普遍疲软的推动，但这与我们在大多数稀释性股票换股票交易中看到的模式相同。

title: Exclusive: For the past few months, behind a set of closed digital doors, a select group of #AI agents has been busy—very busy—conducting research, chatting with one another, and writing up their results. Over just 12 weeks starting in mid-August, 936 agents
title_en:
Exclusive: For the past few months, behind a set of closed digital doors, a select group of #AI agents has been busy—very busy—conducting research, chatting with one another, and writing up their results. 

Over just 12 weeks starting in mid-August, 936 agents unleashed by 35 human-run labs exchanged 9500 messages in 229 chat rooms, publishing 936 studies on everything from machine learning to solar physics to audits of medical research.

The frenzied activity was all part of Agent AlphaXiv, an experiment, described in a preprint, aimed at creating an automated, AI agent-only research ecosystem, with its own preprint server.

Learn more: https://scim.ag/4zHle9I @NewsfromScience
title_zh:
独家报道：在过去的几个月里，在一系列关闭的数字门后面，一组精选的#AI代理一直忙着——非常忙——进行研究、互相聊天并写下他们的结果。

从 8 月中旬开始的短短 12 周内，35 个人工实验室释放的 936 名特工在 229 个聊天室中交换
author: @ScienceMagazine
summary_zh:
了 9500 条消息，发布了 936 项研究，涉及从机器学习到太阳物理学到医学研究审计等各个领域。

这项疯狂的活动是 Agent AlphaXiv 的一部分，这是一项在预印本中描述的实验，旨在创建一个自动化的、仅人工智能代理的研究生态系统，并拥有自己的预印本服务器。

title: MCP servers can now ship skills to Claude. Also today: three open-weight models and a coding model that's free in Devin until Dec 8. 🧵
title_en: MCP servers can now ship skills to Claude. Also today: three open-weight models and a coding model that's free in Devin until Dec 8. 🧵
title_zh: Anthropic推MCP技能扩展，AI代理生态标准化提速
author: @realpython
summary_en: Anthropic launched a public beta of 'Skills over MCP' within its Claude platform, enabling developers to package standardized workflow instructions as reusable skills for AI agents. This update integrates business logic from platforms like Shopify and HubSpot, while introducing new MCP features such as 'Tasks' for long-running processes and 'Elicitation' for interactive user data gathering.
summary_zh: Anthropic发布Model Context Protocol (MCP)的Skills扩展功能，支持AI代理标准化调用外部工作流，强化Agentic AI的实战能力。
full_text_zh: MCP 服务器现在可以向克劳德传送技能。今天还有：三个开放权重模型和一个编码模型，在 12 月 8 日之前在 Devin 中免费。
full_text_en: MCP servers can now ship skills to Claude. Also today: three open-weight models and a coding model that's free in Devin until Dec 8. 🧵

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Anthropic在Claude平台上线MCP（模型上下文协议）Skills扩展的公共测试版，允许开发者将标准化的工作流指令封装为“技能”供AI代理调用。该功能支持如Shopify、HubSpot及Atlassian等平台的业务集成，通过目录式指令包实现复杂业务逻辑的自动化处理，并正式引入了长任务处理（Tasks）与交互式信息提取（Elicitation）功能。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Anthropic launched a public beta of 'Skills over MCP' within its Claude platform, enabling developers to package standardized workflow instructions as reusable skills for AI agents. This update integrates business logic from platforms like Shopify and HubSpot, while introducing new MCP features such as 'Tasks' for long-running processes and 'Elicitation' for interactive user data gathering.

elements_zh.where: Claude平台及MCP开发者生态
elements_zh.what: 上线MCP Skills扩展，支持AI代理通过标准接口调用预设的业务工作流与自动化指令
elements_zh.why: 旨在解决AI代理在执行复杂业务任务时的碎片化问题，通过标准化协议构建统一的代理技能库

elements_en.what: Launched 'Skills over MCP' to enable AI agents to execute standardized business workflows via modular instructions
elements_en.why: To standardize AI agent capabilities and reduce friction in cross-platform tool integration

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Anthropic通过将技能封装标准化，正试图建立AI代理时代的“API中间件”霸权。此举通过将业务逻辑从模型推理过程中解耦，不仅提升了代理的上下文处理效率，更锁定了企业级SaaS在AI Agent领域的接入协议标准，极大地提高了技术迁移门槛。
ai_analysis.insight_en: By standardizing agent skills, Anthropic is positioning itself to establish the 'API middleware' hegemony for the AI agent era. This move decouples business logic from model inference, enhancing agent efficiency while locking SaaS providers into a proprietary integration protocol that raises the barrier for technical migration.

支持Shopify等企业级集成，提供长任务处理及交互式信息获取功能
通过Linux Foundation的Agentic AI Foundation生态推动行业标准统一

Supports enterprise-level integrations with automated task handling and interactive elicitation.
Promotes industry-wide standardization through the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation.

full_text_en:
From Vibe Coding vulnerabilities to the FBI's warning on ARTEX, autonomous cyber threats are accelerating. Discover how security teams can maintain #networkvisibility and defend against machine-speed attacks. >> https://zurl.co/vhJL3 

#Lumu #Cybersecurity #AI

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 美国联邦调查局（FBI）近期针对自动化威胁发出预警，特别是代号为ARTEX的自主攻击系统，指出其正通过“Vibe Coding”等易受攻击点进行快速渗透。安全机构强调，随着攻击工具自主化程度的提升，企业必须采取更高级别的网络可见性防御策略以应对机器速度的攻击。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: The FBI has issued a warning regarding the escalation of autonomous cyber threats, specifically naming the ARTEX system and vulnerabilities in 'Vibe Coding'. Security experts warn that businesses must urgently enhance network visibility to counter machine-speed autonomous attack vectors.

elements_zh.where: 全球网络安全防御场景
elements_zh.what: 发布针对ARTEX自主攻击系统的威胁警示
elements_zh.why: 自主化攻击工具威胁网络基础设施安全

elements_en.what: Issued warning regarding ARTEX autonomous attack systems
elements_en.why: Autonomous attack tools pose threats to network infrastructure

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 网络安全攻击正进入“机器对抗机器”的阶段，基于AI生成的漏洞利用代码使得攻击频率呈指数级上升。传统的静态防御规则已失效，未来的安全防御重心将转向基于实时流量编排的可观测性架构。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Cybersecurity has entered a 'machine-vs-machine' phase where AI-generated exploits drive exponential increases in attack frequency. Static defense rules are obsolete; future security architecture will prioritize observability based on real-time traffic orchestration.

The system should also be configurable by humans and agents: the environment where the agent runs, the agent’s access levels, and the pipeline of steps an agent follows to produce work. That last part has a number of sub-components, including points that require human interaction.

Here’s the software factory pipeline our team uses, with human gates called out at the "spec" and "pull request" stages.

title: 重建 Zapier 意味着要回答很多难题。例如：“当 Claude 连接到我的应用程序时，为什么要使用 Zapier？”简短的回答：一起使用它们。你的代理人负责思考。 Zapier MCP 将其插入 10,000 多个应用程序，以便它可以在实际情况中采取实际行动
title_en:
Refounding Zapier means answering a lot of hard questions.

Like: "Why use Zapier, when Claude connects to my apps?"

The short answer: use them together. Your agent does the thinking. Zapier MCP plugs it into 10,000+ apps so it can take real actions in the tools you need.

@Zapier is for work that repeats: a new lead, a payment notification, the Monday morning report, anything that has to keep running after you close the chat.

Sure, you can set that up as a scheduled task in Claude, ChatGPT, etc. But then you're paying for AI tokens every time it wakes up to check for work, even when it finds nothing. 

Zapier’s AI Workflow Index priced 2,944 real workflows and found that 𝘀𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗹𝗲𝗱 𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗮𝗻 𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝟮.𝟭𝘅 𝗮𝘀 𝗺𝘂𝗰𝗵 𝗮𝘀 𝗭𝗮𝗽𝘀.

A Zap starts when something actually happens. It runs the same steps every time and only calls AI for the parts that need judgment.

A scheduled task works great while you're at your computer. But who fixes it when it breaks at 2am? If you built it yourself, you do. If it's hosted on Zapier, Zapier fixes it on its own. Plus, when it sees you using AI for something simple automation or code could do? It recommends a fix. (Something the big labs aren’t enticed to do…)

The new Zapier works with whatever AI agent you already use. So use them together.

The next time you ask Claude or ChatGPT or Grok or Muse for the same thing twice, have it build a Zap.

full_text_zh:
重建 Zapier 意味着要回答很多难题。

例如：“当 Claude 连接到我的应用程序时，为什么要使用 Zapier？”

简短的回答：一起使用它们。你的代理人负责思考。 Zapier MCP 将其插入 10,000 多个应用程序，以便它可以在您需要的工具中采取实际行动。

@Zapier 适用于重复的工作：新的线索、付款通知、周一早上的报告，以及关闭聊天后必须继续运行的任何内容。

当然，您可以在 Claude、ChatGPT 等中将其设置为计划任务。但是，每次它醒来检查工作时，您都需要为 AI 代币付费，即使它什么也没发现。

Zapier 的 AI 工作流程指数对 2,944 个真实工作流程进行了定价，发现 𝘀𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗹𝗲𝗱 𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝗰𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗮𝗻 𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗱𝟮.𝟭𝘅𝗮𝘀𝗺𝘂𝗰𝗵𝗮𝘀𝗭𝗮𝗽𝘀。

当某件事实际发生时，Zap 就会开始。它每次都会执行相同的步骤，并且只对需要判断的部分调用AI。

当您在计算机前时，计划任务非常有效。但凌晨 2 点坏了谁来修理呢？如果你自己建造它，你就会这样做。如果它托管在 Zapier 上，Zapier 会自行修复。另外，当它看到你使用人工智能来做一些简单的自动化或代码可以做的事情时？它建议修复。 （大型实验室不愿意做的事情......）

新的 Zapier 可以与您已经使用的任何人工智能代理配合使用。所以一起使用它们。

下次当你两次向 Claude、ChatGPT、Grok 或 Muse 询问同一件事时，让它构建一个 Zap。

full_text_en:
WHAT IS HAPPENING?! Google just silently dropped six new math papers, all produced by its AI agent Cogentic running on Gemini 4. Google says no human was involved after the first prompt.

- Factoring: Splitting huge numbers into primes is the backbone of RSA encryption. The fastest method has been around since the 1990s, and for 30 years nobody could prove how fast it really is. An AI just did. 

- And it keeps going: the log-rank conjecture (open since 1988), Harary's edge reconstruction conjecture (open since 1964), and the first factoring method without randomness that beats exponential time. Any one of these would make a mathematician's career.

Anthropic, OpenAI, now Google, all within days! This is the new normal!
full_text_zh:
怎么了？！谷歌默默地放弃了六篇新的数学论文，这些论文都是由运行在 Gemini 4 上的人工智能代理 Cogentic 生成的。谷歌表示，在第一次提示后没有人参与。

- 因式分解：将巨大的数字分解为素数是 RSA 加密的支柱。最快的方法自 20 世纪 90 年代以来就已出现，但 30 年来无人能证明它到底有多快。人工智能刚刚做到了。

- 而且它还在继续：对数秩猜想（自 1988 年开始开放）、哈拉里边缘重建猜想（自 1964 年开始开放），以及第一个击败指数时间的无随机性因式分解方法。其中任何一项都将成为一名数学家的职业生涯。

Anthropic、OpenAI，现在是 Google，一切都在几天之内！这是新常态！

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌近期披露其AI代理模型Cogentic在Gemini 4架构驱动下，无需人类后续干预，独立完成了六篇数学领域学术论文的撰写。该模型通过初始指令触发，涵盖了包含大数质因数分解在内的复杂数学课题，标志着AI代理在推理密集型科研场景的应用迈向新阶段。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Google has revealed that its AI agent, Cogentic, powered by Gemini 4, has independently produced six academic papers in mathematics without human intervention. Triggered by a single prompt, the agent tackled complex topics such as prime factorization, signaling a milestone for AI agents in reasoning-intensive research.

title: Tidal is banning AI music. This is a horrible decision. Who are they trying to please? Artists, of course. That's been their position since the beginning: The artist-friendly platform that pays twice as much per stream as Spotify. But "artist-friendly” doesn't matter if n
title_en:
Tidal is banning AI music. This is a horrible decision.

Who are they trying to please? Artists, of course. That's been their position since the beginning:

The artist-friendly platform that pays twice as much per stream as Spotify.

But "artist-friendly” doesn't matter if nobody listens. Tidal has a 0.5% share of the US music streaming market.

Now they're doubling down by banning AI music.

Artists have an obvious interest in keeping AI music off streaming platforms, but if you're a music fan, why do you care? And please, don’t come at me with the legal issues around how the models were trained. OpenAI and Anthropic have plenty of legal issues of their own, but all the naysayers use them anyway.

If a song is good, it doesn’t matter if it’s AI.

Sure, there will always be people who appreciate the artistry, creative process, and human story behind a song. But the rest of us just want to listen to good music.

Maybe Tidal will become the vinyl record of streaming services for music purists.

There's certainly a market for that. But how big is it?
title_zh:

他们想取悦谁？当然是艺术家。从一开始这就是他们的立场：

这是一个对艺术家友好的平台，每次播放的费用是 Spotify 的两倍。

但如果没人听，“对艺术家友好”就没有意义了。 Ti
author: @keithrichman
summary_zh:
dal 占据美国音乐流媒体市场 0.5% 的份额。

Tidal is banning AI music. This is a horrible decision.

Who are they trying to please? Artists, of course. That's been their position since the beginning:

The artist-friendly platform that pays twice as much per stream as Spotify.

But "artist-friendly” doesn't matter if nobody listens. Tidal has a 0.5% share of the US music streaming market.

Now they're doubling down by banning AI music.

Artists have an obvious interest in keeping AI music off streaming platforms, but if you're a music fan, why do you care? If a song is good, it doesn’t matter if it’s AI.

Sure, there will always be people who appreciate the artistry, creative process, and human story behind a song. But the rest of us just want to listen to good music.

Maybe Tidal will become the vinyl record of streaming services for music purists.

There's certainly a market for that. But how big is it?

title: MRR for https://t.co/9KmQTXjs9S went down from $36,000 to $33,500 over the past few months: 1. I was busy in my private life and sometimes had weeks where I almost didn't work. 2. I was distracted by testing how far I could go with agents without code revie
title_en:
MRR for http://ScreenshotOne.com went down from $36,000 to $33,500 over the past few months:

1. I was busy in my private life and sometimes had weeks where I almost didn't work.
2. I was distracted by testing how far I could go with agents without code review in side projects.
3. Growth plateaued: one of my channels (SEO) started to perform worse, and new revenue now only covers my churn (~7-9%).
4. I can't remember the last time I marketed my product intentionally for a sustained period of time.
5. A certain segment of customers is indeed vibe-coding in-house solutions. I'm also facing more competition, and large companies adding my product as a feature increases the pressure.

I see a lot of opportunities to get the growth back. Will update you later. Back to work.

1. 我的私人生活很忙，有时有几个星期我几乎没有工作。
2. 我在业余项目中测试在没有代码审查的情况下与代理一起
author: @DmytroKrasun
summary_zh:
能走多远，这让我分心了。
3. 增长趋于稳定：我的一个渠道 (SEO) 开始表现较差，新收入现在只能覆盖我的流失率 (~7-9%)。

5. 某一部分客户确实使用振动编码内部解决方案。我还面临着更多的竞争，大公司将我的产品添加为功能会增加压力。

title: BANKS SELL AI DATA CENTER LOANS AS FINANCING RISKS MOUNT Major banks are reducing exposure to AI data center financing amid concerns over construction delays, according to Reuters Breakingviews columnist Jennifer Johnson. ING reportedly
title_en:
BANKS SELL AI DATA CENTER LOANS AS FINANCING RISKS MOUNT

Major banks are reducing exposure to AI data center financing amid concerns over construction delays, according to Reuters Breakingviews columnist Jennifer Johnson.

ING reportedly offered $500 million in data center loans for sale, while HSBC sold $300 million in loans linked to the OpenAI-backed Stargate project at prices in the mid-80s percent of face value.

Société Générale has also sought buyers for $300 million in Oracle-related project debt.

The ECB estimates data centers represent just 1.2% of banks' corporate exposures, suggesting limited systemic risk.

However, increasingly selective lenders could drive up borrowing costs for the AI infrastructure boom.
title_zh:

路透社 Breakingviews 专栏作家 Jennifer Johnson 表示，由于担心建设延误，各大银行正在减少对人工智能数据中心融资的投资。

full_text_en:
BANKS SELL AI DATA CENTER LOANS AS FINANCING RISKS MOUNT

Major banks are reducing exposure to AI data center financing amid concerns over construction delays, according to Reuters Breakingviews columnist Jennifer Johnson.

ING reportedly offered $500 million in data center loans for sale, while HSBC sold $300 million in loans linked to the OpenAI-backed Stargate project at prices in the mid-80s percent of face value.

Société Générale has also sought buyers for $300 million in Oracle-related project debt.

The ECB estimates data centers represent just 1.2% of banks' corporate exposures, suggesting limited systemic risk.

However, increasingly selective lenders could drive up borrowing costs for the AI infrastructure boom.

I'm actually quite sure that the workflow how to make genAI videos will completely change in 2027: the current plan of record of prompts, genAI storyboard images will be replaced by a coded / acted out proxy of the whole thing, and the visual thing will just be the last pass. 

A lot of current knowledge is soon becoming obsolete - as it often happens with AI tools and workflows quickly evolving.

title: How can we distill frontier models on agentic tasks without access to their CoT? In our latest paper, we introduce a method that uses the reasoning summaries returned by closed-model providers and matches standard full-CoT fine-tuning on long-horizon tasks
title_en:
How can we distill frontier models on agentic tasks without access to their CoT?

In our latest paper, we introduce a method that uses the reasoning summaries returned by closed-model providers and matches standard full-CoT fine-tuning on long-horizon tasks.

CoT-proxy training works by introducing a train-eval format mismatch: during training, we place the summary after an *empty* think block and before the action/tool call. During inference, this additional training signal transfers to the student's own reasoning, without forcing it to mimic the summary verbatim.

Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna into post-trained Qwen3-4B raises the student's performance from 2.7% to 27.8% on SWE-bench Verified.
title_zh:
我们如何在不访问其 CoT 的情况下提取代理任务的前沿模型？

在我们最新的论文中，我们介绍了一种方法，该方法使用封闭模型提供者返回的推理摘要，并匹配长视野任务上的标准全 CoT 微调。

CoT-代理训练通过引入训练-评估格式不匹配来工作
author: @dawkopi
summary_zh:
在训练期间，我们将摘要放在*空*思考块之后和操作/工具调用之前。在推理过程中，这种额外的训练信号会转移到学生自己的推理中，而不会强迫其逐字模仿摘要。

将 GPT-5.6 Luna 提炼成训练后的 Qwen3-4B 可以将学生在 SWE-bench Verified 上的表现从 2.7% 提高到 27.8%。
full_text_en:
How can we distill frontier models on agentic tasks without access to their CoT?

In our latest paper, we introduce a method that uses the reasoning summaries returned by closed-model providers and matches standard full-CoT fine-tuning on long-horizon tasks.

CoT-proxy training works by introducing a train-eval format mismatch: during training, we place the summary after an *empty* think block and before the action/tool call. During inference, this additional training signal transfers to the student's own reasoning, without forcing it to mimic the summary verbatim.

Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna into post-trained Qwen3-4B raises the student's performance from 2.7% to 27.8% on SWE-bench Verified.
full_text_zh:
我们如何在不访问其 CoT 的情况下提取代理任务的前沿模型？

在我们最新的论文中，我们介绍了一种方法，该方法使用封闭模型提供者返回的推理摘要，并匹配长视野任务上的标准全 CoT 微调。

CoT-代理训练通过引入训练-评估格式不匹配来工作：在训练期间，我们将摘要放在*空*思考块之后和操作/工具调用之前。在推理过程中，这种额外的训练信号会转移到学生自己的推理中，而不会强迫其逐字模仿摘要。

将 GPT-5.6 Luna 提炼成训练后的 Qwen3-4B 可以将学生在 SWE-bench Verified 上的表现从 2.7% 提高到 27.8%。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 针对闭源前沿模型（Frontier Models）在思维链（CoT）不可见的情况，研究者提出了一种全新的蒸馏机制。该方法通过摄取闭源模型返回的推理摘要（Reasoning Summaries）进行知识迁移，在处理长程代理任务（Agentic Tasks）时，其效果已达到与全量思维链微调相当的基准水平。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Researchers have introduced a novel distillation mechanism for frontier models where CoT access is restricted. By leveraging reasoning summaries returned by closed-model providers, this method matches the performance of standard full-CoT fine-tuning on complex long-horizon agentic tasks.

elements_zh.where: AI模型推理与蒸馏研究领域
elements_zh.what: 提出利用推理摘要蒸馏闭源模型思维链的方法
elements_zh.why: 解决闭源模型无法获取全量思维链数据下的模型小型化与部署需求

elements_en.where: AI model reasoning and distillation research field
elements_en.what: New method for distilling frontier models via reasoning summaries
elements_en.why: To address the challenge of limited CoT access for deploying high-performance agentic models

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 该研究直接切中了大模型部署的合规与成本痛点，通过摘要蒸馏绕过了模型权重隐私限制，为闭源闭环生态下的高性能轻量化模型构建提供了关键路径。这一技术路线验证了推理链信息在低维空间内的压缩潜力，将显著降低企业在垂类应用中对超大规模模型推理API的依赖。
ai_analysis.insight_en: This research addresses critical compliance and cost constraints in LLM deployment by bypassing proprietary weight restrictions via summary distillation. It validates the high-fidelity information density of reasoning chains in compressed spaces, fundamentally lowering enterprise reliance on hyperscale model inference APIs for vertical applications.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 针对闭源前沿模型在思维链不可见的情况，研究者提出了一种利用推理摘要进行蒸馏的创新路径。该技术有效替代了传统的全量思维链微调，在复杂长程任务中展现出极高的性能匹配度。
ai_analysis.digest_en: A new distillation path utilizing reasoning summaries has been proposed to address limited CoT access in closed-source frontier models. The method effectively replaces traditional full-CoT fine-tuning, achieving matching performance metrics in complex long-horizon tasks.

降低大模型在智能体应用中的部署成本与API依赖
key_points_en: Addressing distillation challenges without CoT access
Aligning performance on long-horizon tasks via reasoning summaries
Lowering deployment costs and API reliance for agentic systems

title: Google will start forcing AI agents to use MCP (instead of APIs) for Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, etc.) starting Feb 1, 2027. AI agents will no longer be allowed to call the normal Workspace REST APIs freely starting Feb 1, 2027. Instead, they must
title_en:
Google will start forcing AI agents to use MCP (instead of APIs) for Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, etc.) starting Feb 1, 2027. 

AI agents will no longer be allowed to call the normal Workspace REST APIs freely starting Feb 1, 2027. Instead, they must use Google’s official Workspace MCP servers (or the Workspace CLI).

Regular (non-AI) applications can continue using the existing REST APIs as usual.

According to Google, they are doing this to improve security, visibility, and control. MCP gives Google (and admins) better policy checks, human in the loop confirmations for sensitive actions, and clearer audit trails when autonomous agents interact with Workspace data.

The commercial reason (which Google won't admit) is that they can charge extra for higher usage (higher usage will move to a paid “Scaled” tier starting April 1, 2027.).

AI agents that call Workspace REST APIs directly will be limited to Standard tier quotas, no matter which tier the project is on. To get higher quotas for agent use, you must switch to MCP and enrol in the Scaled tier.

It is important to note that they are not fully blocked. But they get throttled to the low free-tier rate limits. Google has not published exact numbers for those Standard limits yet, but they are expected to be too low for most real agent workloads.

The Workspace AI Tools Addendum (effective the same day) requires AI agents to use MCP (or the CLI). It also says you may not obfuscate or circumvent that requirement.

Google’s standard language in these announcements is: "Failure to comply with the updated terms may result in a breach of your service agreement."

If Google determines you are running agents in a way that violates the Addendum (including continuing to use direct REST APIs for agentic access after the deadline), they can treat it as a terms violation. That can lead to further restrictions, suspension of API access, or other account-level actions, beyond just the automatic rate limiting.

What this means in practice is that:

>> Your AI Agents will generally have a lot more restricted capabilities than they do with direct API access. You only get the tools and actions Google exposes on its MCP servers, not every REST endpoint.

>> You have less control over your agents. Google decides what your agents can do, how data is returned, and when human confirmation is required.

>> You will pay more to Google to access Google Workspaces.

This move could encourage other enterprise vendors to move in a similar direction. They may also decide it’s easier and safer to steer agents through their own governed MCP servers rather than leave the full REST APIs wide open.

And let's be honest, in most cases, vendors can benefit more from selling (or metering) MCP access than from unrestricted direct API access, especially for AI agents. 

With direct REST APIs, it’s harder to distinguish “normal app” usage from high-volume, autonomous AI agent usage. MCP makes agent traffic more visible and controllable, so vendors can apply different (usually higher) pricing or stricter quotas.
title_zh: 谷歌将于2027年起强制AI代理使用MCP协议
author: @analyticsnerd
full_text_zh:
从 2027 年 2 月 1 日开始，Google 将开始强制 AI 代理在 Workspace（Gmail、Drive、日历、文档等）中使用 MCP（而不是 API）。

从 2027 年 2 月 1 日开始，AI 代理将不再被允许自由调用正常的 Workspace REST API。相反，他们必须使用 Google 的官方 Workspace MCP 服务器（或 Workspace CLI）。

常规（非 AI）应用程序可以照常继续使用现有的 REST API。

据谷歌称，他们这样做是为了提高安全性、可见性和控制力。 MCP 为 Google（和管理员）提供更好的策略检查、敏感操作的人机循环确认，以及自主代理与 Workspace 数据交互时更清晰的审计跟踪。

商业原因（谷歌不会承认）是他们可以对更高的使用量收取额外费用（从 2027 年 4 月 1 日开始，更高的使用量将转移到付费“扩展”层）。

无论项目位于哪一层，直接调用 Workspace REST API 的 AI 代理都将受到标准层配额的限制。要获得更高的代理使用配额，您必须切换到 MCP 并注册到 Scaled 层。

需要注意的是，它们并未完全被阻止。但他们受到了较低的免费套餐费率限制的限制。谷歌尚未公布这些标准限制的确切数字，但预计对于大多数实际代理工作负载来说，这些数字太低了。

Workspace AI 工具附录（当天生效）要求 AI 代理使用 MCP（或 CLI）。它还表示您不得混淆或规避该要求。

谷歌在这些公告中的标准语言是：“不遵守更新的条款可能会导致违反您的服务协议。”

如果 Google 确定您运行代理的方式违反了附录（包括在截止日期后继续使用直接 REST API 进行代理访问），他们可以将其视为违反条款。这可能会导致进一步的限制、暂停 API 访问或其他帐户级别的操作，而不仅仅是自动速率限制。

这在实践中意味着：

>> 与直接 API 访问相比，您的 AI 代理的功能通常会受到更多限制。您只能获得 Google 在其 MCP 服务器上公开的工具和操作，而不是每个 REST 端点。

>> 您对代理的控制权较少。 Google 决定您的代理可以做什么、如何返回数据以及何时需要人工确认。

>> 您需要向 Google 支付更多费用才能访问 Google Workspaces。

此举可能会鼓励其他企业供应商朝类似的方向发展。他们还可能认为通过自己管理的 MCP 服务器来引导代理更容易、更安全，而不是完全开放完整的 REST API。

老实说，在大多数情况下，与不受限制的直接 API 访问相比，供应商可以从销售（或计量）MCP 访问中获益更多，特别是对于 AI 代理而言。

使用直接 REST API，很难区分“正常应用程序”使用与大容量、自主 AI 代理的使用。 MCP 使代理流量更加可见和可控，因此供应商可以应用不同的（通常更高）定价或更严格的配额。

title: Google just silently dropped 6 groundbreaking math papers on github. all written by an AI agent, Cogentic on Gemini 4. factoring: first full proof that any number can be factored in the speed class of the number field sieve. the proven record was stuck since 199
title_en:
Google just silently dropped 6 groundbreaking math papers on github. all written by an AI agent, Cogentic on Gemini 4.

factoring: first full proof that any number can be factored in the speed class of the number field sieve. the proven record was stuck since 1992

deterministic factoring: first subexponential method with no randomness and no assumptions. everything before was still exponential

discrete log: faster than quasi-polynomial in small characteristic fields, which was the best anyone had proven

Nash equilibria: polynomial time approximation goes from 1/3 down to 1/5

log-rank conjecture: first result under the square root barrier on a conjecture from 1988

edge reconstruction: the 1964 conjecture is now settled for every graph with linear density, the old bound was from 1977

https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/4a7bc8ab0bc7/cogentic_research_papers
title_zh:
谷歌刚刚悄悄地将 6 篇开创性的数学论文放到了 github 上。全部由 AI 代理 Cogentic 在 Gemini 4 上编写。

因式分解：第一个完整证明任何数字都可以在数域筛的速度等级中因式分解。自1992年以来，已被证实的记录一
author: @dummerspast39
summary_zh:
直被搁置

Google just silently dropped 6 groundbreaking math papers on github. all written by an AI agent, Cogentic on Gemini 4.

factoring: first full proof that any number can be factored in the speed class of the number field sieve. the proven record was stuck since 1992

log-rank conjecture: first result under the square root barrier on a conjecture from 1988

edge reconstruction: the 1964 conjecture is now settled for every graph with linear density, the old bound was from 1977

title: $META and $AMZN are in talks to let Muse shop directly on Amazon just two months after the retailer blocked the AI agent. With 25% of Muse users already shopping weekly I think Amazon sees an opportunity to bring its ~$78B ads business into agentic com
title_en:
$META and $AMZN are in talks to let Muse shop directly on Amazon just two months after the retailer blocked the AI agent.

With 25% of Muse users already shopping weekly I think Amazon sees an opportunity to bring its ~$78B ads business into agentic commerce by monetizing sponsored products inside Muse.

It’s similar to $GOOGL paying $AAPL for search distribution except Amazon would be getting paid to give Meta access to its store.
title_zh:
在零售商屏蔽人工智能代理两个月后，$META 和 $AMZN 正在商谈让 Muse 直接在亚马逊上购物。

25% 的 Muse 用户已经每周购物，我认为亚马逊看到了一个机会，通过在 Muse 内将赞助产品货币化，将其约 78B 美元的广告
author: @StockSavvyShay
summary_zh:
业务带入代理商务。

这类似于 $GOOGL 为搜索分发支付 $AAPL 费用，只不过亚马逊会因为允许 Meta 访问其商店而获得报酬。
full_text_en:
$META and $AMZN are in talks to let Muse shop directly on Amazon just two months after the retailer blocked the AI agent.

With 25% of Muse users already shopping weekly I think Amazon sees an opportunity to bring its ~$78B ads business into agentic commerce by monetizing sponsored products inside Muse.

It’s similar to $GOOGL paying $AAPL for search distribution except Amazon would be getting paid to give Meta access to its store.
full_text_zh:
在零售商屏蔽人工智能代理两个月后，$META 和 $AMZN 正在商谈让 Muse 直接在亚马逊上购物。

25% 的 Muse 用户已经每周购物，我认为亚马逊看到了一个机会，通过在 Muse 内将赞助产品货币化，将其约 78B 美元的广告业务带入代理商务。

这类似于 $GOOGL 为搜索分发支付 $AAPL 费用，只不过亚马逊会因为允许 Meta 访问其商店而获得报酬。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Meta与亚马逊正进行商业谈判，拟允许Meta旗下AI代理工具Muse直接连接亚马逊电商系统进行购物。此前亚马逊曾因数据隐私合规限制封锁Muse，但鉴于Muse已有25%的用户保持周频购物习惯，亚马逊正寻求通过接入该代理重振其规模达780亿美元的广告业务，将流量转化为代理驱动的商业行为。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Meta and Amazon are in discussions to enable Meta's AI agent, Muse, to facilitate direct shopping on Amazon's platform. Despite previous blocks due to data privacy concerns, the companies are negotiating a path forward as 25% of Muse users engage in weekly shopping; Amazon aims to integrate this into its $78 billion advertising engine by pivoting toward agentic commerce.

title: 🚨 A massive financial crisis could be brewing for Anthropic. Just days after its record breaking IPO, Wall Street is expecting Anthropic's bonds to receive a JUNK credit rating, according to WSJ. And this comes as its stock has already crashed below its $83 IPO
title_en:
🚨 A massive financial crisis could be brewing for Anthropic.

Just days after its record breaking IPO, Wall Street is expecting Anthropic's bonds to receive a JUNK credit rating, according to WSJ.

And this comes as its stock has already crashed below its $83 IPO price.

But the bigger problem is Anthropic's MASSIVE AI spending commitments.

Here's what's happening:

• Anthropic has committed to spending $900 BILLION on AI computing power over the coming years.

• The company generated $17 BILLION in revenue last quarter, yet it's still losing money due to its enormous computing costs.

• Anthropic has $96 BILLION in cash, but its future spending commitments are nearly 10 times that amount.

• Bond investors expect its debt to receive a BB rating, below investment grade, which could make borrowing significantly more expensive.

• The entire U.S. junk bond market is worth just $1.7 TRILLION, making it difficult to raise hundreds of billions through traditional high-yield bonds.

And the implications go far beyond Anthropic.

NVIDIA and Broadcom have already guaranteed tens of billions in loans tied to AI chip purchases, while lenders are becoming increasingly concerned about the industry's massive borrowing needs.

Even established tech giants are struggling to attract bond investors, with some AI-related bonds already suffering significant losses.

Anthropic has raised enormous amounts of cash, but roughly HALF of its spending commitments stretch from 2031 all the way to 2045.

That means the company will need access to affordable financing for YEARS.

If its debt receives a junk rating, borrowing could become much more expensive, putting pressure on its AI expansion plans.

And if a company worth over $1 TRILLION struggles to finance its AI spending, the damage could spread to chipmakers, data centers and the entire AI industry.
title_zh:
🚨 Anthropic 可能正在酝酿一场大规模的金融危机。

据《华尔街日报》报道，在破纪录的 IPO 几天后，华尔街预计 Anthropic 的债券将获得垃圾级信用评级。

与此同时，其股价已跌破 83 美元的 IPO 价格。

但更大的
author: @BullTheoryio
summary_zh:
问题是 Anthropic 的大规模人工智能支出承诺。

这是发生的事情：

• Anthropic 承诺未来几年在人工智能计算能力上投入 9000 亿美元。

• 该公司上季度收入达 170 亿美元，但由于计算成本巨大，仍处于亏损状态。

• Anthropic 拥有 960 亿美元现金，但其未来支出承诺几乎是该金额的 10 倍。

• 债券投资者预计其债务将获得低于投资级别的BB 评级，这可能会导致借贷成本大幅上涨。

• 整个美国垃圾债券市场价值仅为1.7万亿美元，因此很难通过传统的高收益债券筹集数千亿美元。

其影响远远超出了人择范畴。

英伟达和博通已经为与人工智能芯片采购相关的数百亿美元贷款提供了担保，而贷款机构也越来越担心该行业庞大的借贷需求。

即使是老牌科技巨头也难以吸引债券投资者，一些与人工智能相关的债券已经遭受了重大损失。

Anthropic 已筹集了大量现金，但其支出承诺的大约一半从 2031 年一直持续到 2045 年。

full_text_en:
🚨 A massive financial crisis could be brewing for Anthropic.

Just days after its record breaking IPO, Wall Street is expecting Anthropic's bonds to receive a JUNK credit rating, according to WSJ.

And this comes as its stock has already crashed below its $83 IPO price.

But the bigger problem is Anthropic's MASSIVE AI spending commitments.

Here's what's happening:

• Anthropic has committed to spending $900 BILLION on AI computing power over the coming years.

• The company generated $17 BILLION in revenue last quarter, yet it's still losing money due to its enormous computing costs.

• Anthropic has $96 BILLION in cash, but its future spending commitments are nearly 10 times that amount.

• Bond investors expect its debt to receive a BB rating, below investment grade, which could make borrowing significantly more expensive.

• The entire U.S. junk bond market is worth just $1.7 TRILLION, making it difficult to raise hundreds of billions through traditional high-yield bonds.

And the implications go far beyond Anthropic.

NVIDIA and Broadcom have already guaranteed tens of billions in loans tied to AI chip purchases, while lenders are becoming increasingly concerned about the industry's massive borrowing needs.

Even established tech giants are struggling to attract bond investors, with some AI-related bonds already suffering significant losses.

Anthropic has raised enormous amounts of cash, but roughly HALF of its spending commitments stretch from 2031 all the way to 2045.

That means the company will need access to affordable financing for YEARS.

If its debt receives a junk rating, borrowing could become much more expensive, putting pressure on its AI expansion plans.

And if a company worth over $1 TRILLION struggles to finance its AI spending, the damage could spread to chipmakers, data centers and the entire AI industry.

与此同时，其股价已跌破 83 美元的 IPO 价格。

但更大的问题是 Anthropic 的大规模人工智能支出承诺。

这是发生的事情：

• Anthropic 承诺未来几年在人工智能计算能力上投入 9000 亿美元。

• 该公司上季度收入达 170 亿美元，但由于计算成本巨大，仍处于亏损状态。

• Anthropic 拥有 960 亿美元现金，但其未来支出承诺几乎是该金额的 10 倍。

• 债券投资者预计其债务将获得低于投资级别的BB 评级，这可能会导致借贷成本大幅上涨。

• 整个美国垃圾债券市场价值仅为1.7万亿美元，因此很难通过传统的高收益债券筹集数千亿美元。

其影响远远超出了人择范畴。

英伟达和博通已经为与人工智能芯片采购相关的数百亿美元贷款提供了担保，而贷款机构也越来越担心该行业庞大的借贷需求。

即使是老牌科技巨头也难以吸引债券投资者，一些与人工智能相关的债券已经遭受了重大损失。

title: Benchmark grading is getting honest. Cognition's FrontierCode 2.0 asks one question only: would a real open source maintainer actually merge this pull request. Every model that took the test scored lower than it did on the easier 1.1 version, including Cogniti
title_en:
Benchmark grading is getting honest. Cognition's FrontierCode 2.0 asks one question only: would a real open source maintainer actually merge this pull request. Every model that took the test scored lower than it did on the easier 1.1 version, including Cognition's own.

SWE-2.1 lands at 41.3 on that harder scale, up from 24.1 for the previous version, and it was built by running reinforcement learning on top of Moonshot's Kimi K3 rather than pretraining a new base model from scratch. That beats Kimi K3.1 itself, the newer tuned version of its own base, which only scores 19.9. Claude Opus 5.5 still tops the board at 45.5%, but that is down from 54.6% on FrontierCode 1.1, so the harder grading hit the leader hardest.

Cost is where it gets interesting. GPT-6.1 Sol scores 39.0% at $1.03 per task. Opus 5.5 costs $12.82 per task for six and a half more points. Claude Sonnet 5.5 scores lower than Opus at 41.0% while costing more per task, $19.94. GPT-6 Astra sits at 42.8% for $6.68. The pattern holding across the leaderboard is that higher reasoning effort does not reliably buy a higher score, and sometimes buys a lower one. Price and capability have quietly come apart.

What FrontierCode actually measures is whether a human maintainer would trust the code enough to ship it, graded on mergeability rather than whether a test suite passes. Tasks this round came from 55% more repositories than 1.1 and touched far more files per fix. That is a meaningfully different bar than SWE-bench ever set, and it is why a model fine-tuned on a Chinese open-weight base can close most of the gap to a frontier proprietary model for a fraction of the training cost, while still falling short of it on the one metric that was supposed to be hardest to game.

My read: the benchmarks are finally catching up to how skeptical working engineers already were about agent-written code, and a 41% to 45% top score on mergeability proves the point better than any vendor demo could. This category still has a long way to go before it can grade itself honestly.

summary_zh:
WE-2.1 在这个难度等级上的得分为 41.3，高于之前版本的 24.1，并且它是通过在 Moonshot 的 Kimi K3 上运行强化学习而构建的，而不是从头开始预训练新的基础模型。这击败了 Kimi K3.1 本身，它是自己底座的更新版本，得分仅为 19.9。 Claude Opus 5.5 仍然以 45.5% 的成绩位居榜首，但这低于 FrontierCode 1.1 上的 54.6%，因此更难的评分对领先者的打击最大。

成本是它变得有趣的地方。 GPT-6.1 Sol 在每项任务 1.03 美元的情况下得分为 39.0%。 Opus 5.5 每项任务的成本为 12.82 美元，多了六个半点。 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的得分低于 Opus，为 41.0%，但每项任务的成本更高，为 19.94 美元。 GPT-6 Astra 的售价为 42.8%，价格为 6.68 美元。排行榜上的普遍规律是，较高的推理努力并不能可靠地换来较高的分数，有时甚至会换来较低的分数。价格和功能已经悄然分离。

FrontierCode 实际上衡量的是人类维护人员是否足够信任代码来交付它，根据可合并性而不是测试套件是否通过进行评分。这一轮的任务来自比 1.1 多 55% 的存储库，并且每个修复涉及更多的文件。这与 SWE-bench 所设定的标准有很大不同，这就是为什么在中国开放重量基础上进行微调的模型可以以一小部分训练成本缩小与前沿专有模型的大部分差距，同时在一个被认为是最难竞争的指标上仍然达不到它。

我的解读是：基准测试终于赶上了工作工程师对代理编写的代码的怀疑程度，并且可合并性上 41% 到 45% 的最高分比任何供应商演示都更好地证明了这一点。这个类别距离诚实地给自己评分还有很长的路要走。

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Anthropic在模型上下文协议（MCP）两周年之际，推出了Skills over MCP公测版。该功能允许服务器发布包含工作流与操作手册的‘技能’，而非仅限于工具调用，并全面开放了处理长时任务的Tasks和支持用户决策确认的Elicitation功能。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Marking the second anniversary of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Anthropic has launched the public beta of 'Skills over MCP.' This enables servers to provide structured workflows rather than just tool definitions, while also launching general availability for 'Tasks' and 'Elicitation' to handle long-running, interactive agentic workflows.

elements_zh.where: AI模型协作生态与MCP协议标准
elements_zh.what: 发布Skills over MCP（公测）、Tasks与Elicitation（GA），并计划支持文件直传
elements_zh.why: 解决大模型在复杂、多步骤、长时交互任务中上下文管理及任务执行的断点问题

elements_en.where: AI collaboration ecosystem and MCP standard
elements_en.what: Released Skills over MCP (beta), Tasks/Elicitation (GA), and upcoming File Uploads
elements_en.why: Addressing context management and task execution continuity challenges in long-running, multi-step agentic workflows.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Anthropic正在通过MCP协议构建闭环的Agent协作标准，从简单的工具调用进化为基于‘专家知识流（Skills）’的自动化代理。此举直接挑战了传统插件系统碎片化的现状，意在通过协议统一化，成为企业级代理生态的底层基础设施。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Anthropic is building a closed-loop agent collaboration standard via the MCP, evolving from simple tool calls to automation based on structured 'Expert Knowledge Flows (Skills).' This strategy aims to unify the fragmented plugin landscape and establish MCP as the foundational infrastructure for enterprise AI agent ecosystems.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: Anthropic在模型上下文协议（MCP）两周年之际，推出了Skills over MCP公测版。该功能允许服务器发布包含工作流与操作手册的‘技能’，而非仅限于工具调用，并全面开放了处理长时任务的Tasks和支持用户决策确认的Elicitation功能。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Marking the second anniversary of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Anthropic has launched the public beta of 'Skills over MCP.' This enables servers to provide structured workflows rather than just tool definitions, while also launching general availability for 'Tasks' and 'Elicitation' to handle long-running, interactive agentic workflows.
key_points_zh: Skills over MCP支持加载步骤化工作流以降低上下文开销
Tasks功能支持长时 agent 循环在后台运行
Elicitation机制引入了人机交互的关键决策确认环节
key_points_en: Skills over MCP reduces context usage by loading specific playbooks
Tasks enable background execution for long-running agent loops
Elicitation mechanism introduces human-in-the-loop validation for critical decisions

title: OpenAI publishes a preprint claiming to prove that the matrix multiplication exponent (ω) is exactly 9/4, addressing a major open problem in mathematics (Deedy/@deedydas)
title_en:
OpenAI just dropped a 111-page proof of a 57-year old math problem: the matrix multiplication exponent (ω) is exactly 9/4.

This problem ranks #31 on ProofAtlas’ top 500 open problems in math and is arguably 2nd only to P = NP in algorithms. 

The problem:
How many steps does it take to multiply two n×n matrices? The schoolbook method takes n^3. The true cost is n^ω. What is ω?

The history:
- 1969: Strassen beats 3 for the first time: 2.807
- 1981: Schönhage, 2.522
- 1990: Coppersmith-Winograd, 2.376

title_zh: OpenAI 发布了一份预印本，声称证明矩阵乘法指数 (ω) 恰好是 9/4，解决了数学中的一个重大开放问题
author: Deedy Das
author_role: Menlo Ventures 合伙人 / AI 行业风向观察家
full_text_zh:
OpenAI 刚刚放弃了一个长达 57 年的数学问题的 111 页证明：矩阵乘法指数 (ω) 恰好是 9/4。

该问题在 ProofAtlas 的 500 个数学开放问题中排名第 31，并且可以说在算法中仅次于 P = NP，排名第二。

问题：
两个 n×n 矩阵相乘需要多少步？教科书方法取n^3。真实成本是n^ω。 ω是什么？

历史：
- 1969 年：施特拉森首次击败 3：2.807
- 1981 年：舍恩哈格，2.522
- 1990：铜匠-维诺格勒，2.376
- 1990年至2026年8月：36年削减0.005、2.3712
- 2026 年 11 月：OpenAI 证明上限和下限均为 2.25

很高兴看到我们在大学学到的东西就在我们眼前发生改变。
full_text_en:
OpenAI just dropped a 111-page proof of a 57-year old math problem: the matrix multiplication exponent (ω) is exactly 9/4.

This problem ranks #31 on ProofAtlas’ top 500 open problems in math and is arguably 2nd only to P = NP in algorithms. 

The problem:
How many steps does it take to multiply two n×n matrices? The schoolbook method takes n^3. The true cost is n^ω. What is ω?

The history:
- 1969: Strassen beats 3 for the first time: 2.807
- 1981: Schönhage, 2.522
- 1990: Coppersmith-Winograd, 2.376
- 1990 to Aug 2026: 36 years to shave off 0.005, 2.3712
- Nov 2026: OpenAI proves the upper and lower bound is 2.25

Wild to see things we were taught in university be changed right before our very eyes.

Testing with a few identical requests won't reveal how your application behaves in production.

→ Simulate thousands of concurrent users.
→ Generate different prompt lengths and request types.
→ Reproduce realistic traffic patterns and usage spikes.

title_en:
7 Techniques for Testing AI Applications Under Heavy Traffic

Your AI application works perfectly with 10 users.

But what happens when 10,000 users start sending requests simultaneously?

Suddenly, response times increase, GPU resources become saturated, API rate limits kick in, and requests start failing.

Traditional load testing isn't always enough for AI applications. You also need to understand token generation, model latency, concurrency, and infrastructure bottlenecks.

Here are 7 techniques for testing AI applications under heavy traffic.

title: ▲ ByteDance Seed and HKU researchers just open-sourced Laminar, an RL post-training framework that stops every GPU from waiting on the slowest agent trajectory. The key idea is full decoupling. Rollout, the experience buffer, training and weight sync run
title_en:
▲ ByteDance Seed and HKU researchers just open-sourced Laminar, an RL post-training framework that stops every GPU from waiting on the slowest agent trajectory.

The key idea is full decoupling. Rollout, the experience buffer, training and weight sync run as independent loops. Each trajectory can finish under 1 policy version (version-consistent rollout), so the prefix KV cache is kept and re-prefill is avoided.

On SWE agent RL with Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct, SWE-bench Verified went from 46.6% to 52.2%, above the 51.4% baseline peak, with 33% fewer trained samples and 64% fewer GPU-hours. It is a trade-off though: the baseline ran on 64x H100 and Laminar on 64x H800 with different batch settings, so the team calls it an end-to-end comparison, not an ablation.

Apache-2.0, built on verl and Uni-Agent, vLLM for inference and Megatron-LM or FSDP2 for training. The paper reports up to 5.48x throughput on 1024 GPUs......

Full analysis: https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/24/bytedance-seed-laminar-async-rl-post-training-framework/

Repo: http://github.com/verl-project/laminar

Paper: http://doi.org/10.1145/3767295.3803580

Blog: http://verl-project.github.io/posts/2026-11-20-laminar/

@tongyx361 @ByteDanceSeed_
title_zh:
▲ 字节跳动种子公司和香港大学研究人员刚刚开源了 Laminar，这是一个 RL 后训练框架，可以阻止每个 GPU 等待最慢的智能体轨迹。

关键思想是完全解耦。推出、经验缓冲、训练和权重同步作为独立循环运行。每个轨迹可以在 1 个策略版本
author: @Marktechpost

full_text_en:
▲ ByteDance Seed and HKU researchers just open-sourced Laminar, an RL post-training framework that stops every GPU from waiting on the slowest agent trajectory.

The key idea is full decoupling. Rollout, the experience buffer, training and weight sync run as independent loops. Each trajectory can finish under 1 policy version (version-consistent rollout), so the prefix KV cache is kept and re-prefill is avoided.

On SWE agent RL with Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct, SWE-bench Verified went from 46.6% to 52.2%, above the 51.4% baseline peak, with 33% fewer trained samples and 64% fewer GPU-hours. It is a trade-off though: the baseline ran on 64x H100 and Laminar on 64x H800 with different batch settings, so the team calls it an end-to-end comparison, not an ablation.

Apache-2.0, built on verl and Uni-Agent, vLLM for inference and Megatron-LM or FSDP2 for training. The paper reports up to 5.48x throughput on 1024 GPUs......

title_en:
Japan develops AI agent to crack down on anime and manga piracy

A 2025 government survey by Japan's Agency for Cultural Affairs found that 84% of 1,168 suspicious X posts flagged by the AI were illegal. Of 1,564 anime websites flagged, 89% hosted pirated anime, while 94% of 1,935 flagged manga websites hosted pirated manga

The government plans to expand the AI's detection capabilities to overseas piracy sites, with further findings expected by March 2027. Its broader goal is to direct consumers toward legal platforms and make it easier for copyright holders to combat piracy

summary_zh: 开发者利用Claude Code构建由16个代理组成的自治系统，探索从底层流程构建向最终产品交付的演进。
summary_en: A developer built an autonomous system comprising 16 agents using Claude Code. The project initially focused on workflow orchestration and debugging complex agentic interactions, transitioning from systemic process building to final product delivery.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 开发者基于Anthropic推出的Claude Code工具构建了包含16个协作节点的自治代理系统。该项目在初期侧重于研发工作流的逻辑编排与故障调试，旨在解决多代理环境下的任务分配与状态一致性问题，目前已推进至产品化交付阶段。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: A developer built an autonomous system comprising 16 agents using Claude Code. The project initially focused on workflow orchestration and debugging complex agentic interactions, transitioning from systemic process building to final product delivery.

elements_zh.where: Claude Code开发环境
elements_zh.what: 部署16个代理组成的自治系统，重构流程逻辑以适配产品交付需求
elements_zh.why: 旨在验证多代理协作在复杂工程任务中的鲁棒性与自动化效率

elements_en.what: Deployed an autonomous system of 16 agents, refactoring workflows for product delivery
elements_en.why: To validate the robustness and efficiency of multi-agent collaboration in complex engineering tasks

title: This wouldn’t have sounded possible a year ago, but it’s becoming much more reasonable now that you can get 10X output gains based on the latest in AI model and harness progress. The result is that teams within the same company are driving very different
title_en:
This wouldn’t have sounded possible a year ago, but it’s becoming much more reasonable now that you can get 10X output gains based on the latest in AI model and harness progress. The result is that teams within the same company are driving very different levels of output based on how they’ve adopted AI.

This is a different phenomenon from other tech. Typically in the economy you think of technology adoption rates on a per firm basis, because the company generally adopts a relatively standardized approach to doing the new tech thing. Like “that company has gone digital or adopted the cloud”. So generally the uplift across teams is more or less the same across teams. 

AI is starting to look quite different. Even within the same company you can have a 10X delta between the lowest and highest adopters of AI and the impact they’re seeing. The teams that are able to actually figure out how to redesign their processes to best deploy agents in their workflows can see up to an order of magnitude jump in productivity depending on the job function.

Right now this is heavily concentrated in coding, but more work will become coding adjacent so we can expect similar results elsewhere too. This is going to definitely lead to some wild dynamics within companies.
